stemMarkdown: Find the difference between the compound interest and the simple interest on ₹5000 for 2 years at 8% per annum (interest compounded annually).
solutionMarkdown: SI for 2 years $= \dfrac{P \times r \times t}{100} = \dfrac{5000 \times 8 \times 2}{100} = 800.00$. CI for 2 years $= P\left[(1+r/100)^2 - 1\right] = 5000\left[(1+8/100)^2 - 1\right] = 832.00$. Difference $= 832.00 - 800.00 = 32.00$.
